title: Environment- and Redshift-Dependent Effective Gravity from Dark Sector Coupling: A Unified Framework for Late-Time Cosmic Phenomena
content: Background: ΛCDM faces Hubble tension, S8 tension, and dynamical dark energy evidence. Methods: The Zhao model introduces a direct coupling between dark energy equation of state w and structure growth index γ. Results: Dark energy is reinterpreted as a dynamical response to structure growth; dark-sector energy exchange is the cosmological manifestation of a fifth force, with effective gravity Geff as its macroscopic counterpart. A three-level hierarchical Bayesian strategy ensures falsifiability. Conclusions: With a single parameter ηη, the model unifies void lensing (Aκ < 1), the S8 environmental gradient, the Hubble tension, and structure growth suppression. Upcoming surveys will provide decisive tests, potentially establishing environment- and redshift-dependent effective gravity from dark-sector coupling as a new cosmological paradigm.
